---
title: API
description: WriteStack does not have a public REST API yet. Use the MCP server to automate WriteStack today.
---

There is no public REST API yet. Everything an integration can do today goes through the [MCP server](/docs/build), which any MCP client or agent framework can call over HTTP with OAuth or an [API key](/docs/build/connect/api-key).

When a REST API ships, its reference will live here, generated from its OpenAPI spec.

Want a specific endpoint? [Suggest it](https://writestack.io/features).
